peer.visibilityNote: Frustum/distance eligibility is retained separately from actual render submissions and does not establish unoccluded pixel visibility. Mirror matrices between explicit renders are the recorded native matrices, not a changed camera.
peer.geometryMethod: Actual crowd.set feet/heading/scale/pose and TOP/aLimb0 triangles, intersected at a common native world-height torso plane. TOP is always drawn, including inside a coat; the near torso is contained by the far torso box. This proves positive body intersections for active pose0 walkers; a negative torso plane alone is not a claim about every articulated limb or prop.
